Reasons in this plan Why each slot does what it does; hover a chip in the table for the slot's own figures. Charge from grid Charging from the grid while energy is cheaper. (7 slots) Idle Nothing to gain from moving energy in this slot. (131 slots) Wear > saving Not discharging: the price gap is smaller than the battery's wear cost. (5 slots) Hold for outage Keeping charge in reserve: a likely outage. (23 slots) Genset off The grid is up, so the genset stays off although an outage is likely soon.
